facts.business: HCL Infosystems Limited is an IT support services company focused on executing long-term contracts, recovering legacy receivables through arbitration, and reducing outstanding debt and losses.
key_risks: Delays in customer acceptance and sign-offs leading to receivable recovery delays
Multiple legal proceedings and legacy issues incurring high legal costs
Dependence on promoter group financial support (corporate guarantees, loans, NCDs) for continuity of operations
Counter-claims and contests by customers against arbitration awards
Uncertainty in recovery of long-overdue receivables through arbitration
facts.related_party_note: Financial support of Rs 1,50,000 lakhs approved from HCL Corporation Private Limited (significant promoter shareholder) via corporate guarantees, lien on fixed deposits, and interest-free unsecured loans. Additional support of Rs 1,50,000 lakhs approved from HCL Capital Private Limited (promoter group company) via advances/loans, unsecured NCDs, guarantees, or other financial support. Both approved by shareholders.
